metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Vyomi, the local AWS / GCP / Azure simulator.

plugins.name: vyomi
plugins.description: Run and test cloud code locally against Vyomi (Nano in the browser, or a Pro/Max mesh): scan a repo for AWS/GCP/Azure usage, see what is emulated where, and wire SDKs to it. Needs vyomi-tunnel 1.3.0+.
